name: orion-web CI-CD
originalTriggers: push: main, develop, feature/* (README.md and docs/* excluded)
schedule: cron 0 3 * * 1-5 on main, always: false (only when there are changes)

taskMap.github: actions/cache (same key shape: npm | os | hash of package-lock.json)
run steps: npm install (registry token via NODE_AUTH_TOKEN), npm run build, npm publish
taskMap.note: endpoints orion-npm-registry and orion-npm-feed become a URL variable and a token secret each

taskMap.github: run: rsync -az --delete over ssh with a pinned known_hosts
taskMap.note: host, user, key and known_hosts come from the orion-ssh-web connection and must be provided as variables/secrets

taskMap.github: run: ssh ... sudo systemctl reload nginx

unsupported.reason: Azure shows a Tests tab per matrix leg; only junit.xml is kept as an artifact per Node version
unsupported.suggestion: add a reviewed test-report action (needs checks: write) if the tab is wanted

acceptedWarnings.why: The source gives these jobs no environment and keeps the credentials at repository level (Azure variable groups are not environment-scoped). Scoping them to a GitHub environment is a hardening choice for the reviewer; it would add approvals and deployment records the source does not have.
The source runs on a self-hosted pool; a self-hosted runner group has to exist at the destination.
Same fact reported by zizmor: self-hosted runners are persistent and need hardening that is outside this workflow.

notes: The deploy job needs self-hosted runners with the labels docker and npm (the source's demands, read from the pool by the product and handed to actionlint as the only extra labels it accepts): the destination has to provide runners that have them.
The SSH deployment key is written to the runner's home for the job and removed by an always() step; a persistent self-hosted runner makes that window a risk to review.

The deployment job of the source checks out no sources, so its npm publish ran in an empty directory; the converted step publishes from the downloaded web-dist directory and needs a human to confirm it is the intended package.
NODE_ENV=production is exported as in the source, which makes npm install skip devDependencies for the lint and test steps; keep or fix deliberately.

Pipeline variable SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN (secret) and group secrets SENTRY_DSN and CDN_PURGE_KEY are not referenced by the YAML and are not created. The sharedactions repository resource and the templates variable file are unused by the YAML.
The staging environment's branch control (main, release/*) is configured on the GitHub environment.

templates.handledBy: not converted: its variables (orionRegion, teamsWebhookVariable) are not referenced by the YAML
